No walking, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon, web, silk, threads. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint.
